hypothesis: The source-native enwik9 profile with its built-in train_len=32 and required d_pos=288 coupling retains enough of the authorized 32/32 causal-update gain to save at least 500 actual bytes against the exact 9246-byte 10000-symbol batch-32 LibNC archive while remaining decodable and deterministic.
interfaces_exposed: Native LibNC enwik9 profile -> built-in train_len=32 with d_pos=288 -> two updates per former 64-state interval -> unchanged native archive decoder.
kill_condition: If actual gain is <500 bytes, determinism or raw-prefix decode fails, or decimal memory fails, retire the built-in train_len=32 surrogate. Do not use a miss to retire the distinct exact KV-rebuild schedule.
promotion_condition: Two source-native archives are byte-identical, decode to the exact raw prefix, archive size is <=8746 bytes, and the outer decimal-memory guard passes.
retired_neighborhoods: This freezes only the built-in train_len=32 surrogate; no train-length sweep. It is not numerically equivalent to the exact post-midpoint KV-rebuild child.
title: Source-native NNCP train_len=32 update-cadence surrogate
